title: feat(spec)!: retire FormView drawerSide / drawerWidth — no form view opens in a drawer

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi98wYJuaJ1vEnWCa6xuHrcSS)_
Fixes #29012

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单视图（form view）上的 `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` 两个键退役，写了就在保存时被拒并给出修法；存量数据读取时自动删掉这两个键。React 页面里 `ObjectForm` 组件的同名属性保留不变。
- 为什么改：表单视图早已不能以抽屉方式打开（`type: 'drawer'` 已在本版本退役），控制台、记录表单页和 Studio 都不读这两个键，作者写了能存能发布却毫无效果，属于“声明了但不生效”。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄表单视图的可写键；已存的表单视图读取时被转换，界面上看到的完全一样。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`（两个墓碑和提示文案）、`packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts`（两个属性改由 `ObjectForm` 自己声明）、`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` 的 `form-view-drawer-keys-removed`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo src/ui/form-view-drawer-keys-retirement.test.ts`，应看到 29 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`FormViewSchema.drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` are `retiredKey()` tombstones** (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`). Each is refused at every form-view door (a view's `form`, `formViews.*`, a form view item record, a flattened form overlay, `defineStack` as `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422) with a prescription that says why it was inert, what to do instead (`navigation.mode` / `navigation.size` for a list's record drawer; the React `ObjectForm` block's own props for a page drawer) and the `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence. TypeScript rejects both at a `FormView` position. The describe that deferred the question to closed #27153 is gone.
- **The React `ObjectForm` block keeps both props** (`packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts`). They leave the block's `dataProps` (which read `FormViewSchema`) and move to its overlay as `binding` props with the same types; `drawerSide` keeps its description, and `drawerWidth`'s drops the form view's `[DEPRECATED → size buckets]` tag (the block's drawer has no size bucket) and says what `DrawerForm` does with the value: the drawer's width from the left or right edge, its height from the top or bottom, the #9392 rule for a prop only the react tier reads. The overlay entry shares the tombstone's name, so `REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS.ObjectForm` ledgers it with that reason. The regenerated `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` moves the two rows from the data group to the binding group; `validate-react-page-props` reads the overlay, so a React page's `drawerSide="right"` stays known.
- **ADR-0087 kit.** D2 conversion `form-view-drawer-keys-removed` (`toMajor: 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, `stripKeys` on every form payload and the assembled `viewItems` channel; never walks page components, so the `object-form` page block keeps its keys). D3 semantic entry `ui-form-view-drawer-keys-retired`. `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entries `ui/FormView:drawerSide` and `ui/FormView:drawerWidth`. Step-18 rationale fragment. Removal-version pin rows.
- **Ledger and generated artifacts.** `liveness/view.json`: both rows `dead` with the tombstone note (view counts 75/8 → 73/10). Regenerated `authorable-surface/ui.json` (two `[RETIRED]` rows), `content/docs/references/{api/protocol,ui/view}.mdx`, `liveness/state-counts/view.md`, the react-blocks contract.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29012-form-view-drawer-keys-retired.md`: BREAKING, `minor` on `@objectstack/spec` and `patch` on `@objectstack/skills` (the regenerated `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` ships there, as in #27159's changeset), FROM → TO, the one-line fix, `registered` ADR-0087 marker.

### Forced test edits

- `src/ui/form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts`: the "STATED BOUNDARY: `drawerSide`, `drawerWidth` and `modalSize` stay declared" pin now holds `modalSize` only, and its stored-row case uses `modalSize: 'lg'` as the bystander instead of `drawerSide: 'left'` (the new conversion strips that). The header's bookkeeping line points at the new pin.
- `src/conversions/registry.ts` `form-view-presentation-types-removed` fixture: the `quick` form's bystander is `title: 'Quick'` instead of `drawerSide: 'left'`, because fixtures must stay disjoint under whole-table replay. Its docblock now says the drawer keys left later in the same release.
- `src/ui/view-metadata-schema.test.ts`: the "a FormView key nobody would think to allow-list" probe uses `showStepIndicator` instead of `drawerSide`.
- `src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: the `omit` row for `view.drawerWidth` is dropped, as the ledger asks for a key that became a tombstone.

### New pin

`src/ui/form-view-drawer-keys-retirement.test.ts` (repo project, listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`): both keys refused at five doors with the prescription's first sentence and the migrate sentence; a `modalSize` control at each door; `defineStack` envelope; `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR`; `@ts-expect-error` at the authoring site; the block overlay publishes both and the `object-form` page block still accepts them; the conversion on a stored container and a form view item record, never on a page block, idempotent, off the load path, wired into step 18, with its D3 entry; tree-scoped absence over the five roots spec#test already declares.

## Why

Triage ruling on the card (comment 6571544001): retire under ADR-0049. Measured at `origin/main` 104cd1a5:

- **No form-view surface reads either key.** The only code that hands them to `DrawerForm` is `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectFormContainer.tsx`, which serves the `object-form` block's `formType='drawer'`; a form view's `type` cannot be `drawer` since #27155. `ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/FieldDesigner.tsx` composes its own `DrawerFormSchema` in code. The console form page, the New / Edit dialogs (which read `modalSize` only) and the record form page never read them.
- **The ui prop types are the block's own.** `DrawerForm.tsx` declares `drawerSide?` / `drawerWidth?` on `DrawerFormSchema`, and `@object-ui/types` `ObjectFormSchema` declares its own; neither derives from `FormViewSchema`, so `ui/` needs no edit (checklist 4 measured, below).
- **`drawerWidth`'s size-bucket deprecation had no conversion.** The only conversion text naming it was the presentation-types docblock saying it stays. This entry deletes it; the prescription names `navigation.size`.
- **Authored uses on a form view: 0.** `examples/`: 0 form views (2 hits are `ObjectForm formType="drawer" drawerSide="right"` JSX on React pages, the block, unaffected); `skills/`: 0 (the generated block contract only). Control leg: the live form-view key `submitBehavior` reads 8 in `examples/` on the same tree. HotCRM fixtures are not in this repository: NOT MEASURED.

By source: no `ui/` type derives `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` from `FormView` (`DrawerFormSchema` and `ObjectFormSchema` declare their own; `git grep` of `ui/` for `FormView[` indexes names only `modalSize`, `defaultTab`, `tabPosition`, `layout`, `buttons`, `defaults`). `Type Check UI` on this PR is the reading.

## Acceptance notes

- `.changeset/27155-form-view-type-layout-only.md` (pending, 18.3.0) had an "Unchanged" bullet saying `splitDirection`, `drawerSide`, `drawerWidth` and `modalSize` stay declared. All three notes ship in the same 18.3.0 release, so this PR corrects it: only `modalSize` stays declared (the console reads it for its record dialog), `splitDirection` (#27159) and `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` (#29012) retire from the form view in the same release, and the React `ObjectForm` block keeps the drawer pair as its own props. This is a DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending release note: `check-empty-changeset` exits 1 on it by design, and `Check Changeset` is not a required context. Do not restore the original sentence and do not add `skip-changeset`.
- `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts` (the `ObjectFormSchema` key taxonomy docblock) still lists `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` among the `[spec-aligned]` FormView keys. They are now the block's own props on both sides; a comment only, outside this card's file surface.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` rows that score the drawer keys as "fail today" now meet a save refusal instead of an inert save; the QA lane re-scores them.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` is the generator-owned `spec-react-blocks` row: this diff regenerates it from `react-blocks.ts` and does not touch `packages/spec/scripts/`.
